drums.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A muffled, low-pass filtered kick drum and a crisp, dry snare drum play a boom-bap pattern at 85 BPM in 4/4 time. A Rhodes electric piano plays sustained, jazzy seventh chords with a slight tremolo effect. A deep, sub-heavy electric bass follows the root notes of the piano chords. A recurring vinyl crackle and hiss layer persists throughout the track. A melodic, high-pitched sine wave synth lead plays a simple, repetitive four-bar melody with heavy portamento. The track is in the key of C minor.

[Outro]

[Rhodes piano fades out]
[vinyl crackle persists until silence]
